title: Megurine Luka — Happy Anniversary!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Luka's Anniversary
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika, the stream's about to start.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi... Is it still bothering you that much?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We get that you wanted to go celebrate in person at this place, but there's no use crying over it at this point, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-I'd be fine if it was a matter of my number not being drawn for ordering tickets...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But to think that I'd misread the entry period by a day and not even be able to put my name in...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, you can still celebrate by watching the stream. There's even a comments section where you can send your thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ I mean, we can sorta meet Luka whenever we want, you know? We can't hog her all to ourselves... Right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's true too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But to be fair, she has done quite a lot for us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have a friend who's really important to me, and I want to respect her choices, but by doing that, I also feel like I'm failing her...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have no idea what to do.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What do you wish for?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to do what's right for everyone...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You know, there's no right or wrong in music.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's down to individual interpretation.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Everyone brings their own tune to the table. Think of how you and your friends could put your tunes together into a beautiful melody.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A melody for all of us...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Luka's advice really taught me that I don't have to be in such a rush.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You wanted to get back what you lost.
That seems perfectly normal.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You felt that all those things couldn't wait.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you don't need to be in such a hurry to make up for that time. It's okay to take it easy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's helped me out so much, but all I'm ever able to do for her is draw terrible fortunes...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh? What about the ones you got after redrawing them a few times?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Th-Those just don't mean as much...
I'd really rather draw something good on my first try.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. You'll just have to keep trying!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right! I'm absolutely going to draw a “great blessing” on my first try next time!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And she's been there for me too.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (When Saki got sick and ran that fever, and when Shizuku wanted to do a moon viewing...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, I think the anniversary stream's about to start!
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hello, everyone.
Thank you all for joining me to celebrate my anniversary.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And hello to everyone watching the stream as well. Can you all hear me okay?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I need to write a comment!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<Congratulations, Luka.
I couldn't be there in person, but I'll be watching your stream.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Wow! Look at all the comments!
There are so many!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<“Congratulations, Luka.
I couldn't be there in person, but I'll be watching your stream.”>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Thank you.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I want our viewers to have just as much fun, so we'll try to get to as many comments as we can.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Miku totally just read your comment, didn't she?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-Yes?! Wait, I should reply!
Actually, do you think I should?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm glad you're happy, but try to relax, okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. As a reward for sending me such wonderful comments, let's get right to it!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Ready, Miku?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah! We'll start things off with a little duet!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! This dance is amazing!
Luka and Miku are so good!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Luka's more known for her ballads, but it's nice to see her perform a high-tempo song for a change.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I agree. This might even suit our Luka.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
She's such an adult too. So mature and ladylike.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Maybe I'll grow my hair out a little more and straighten it like Luka♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: With your wavy hair? How long's that gonna last?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll get it to stay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We'll be joining you for this one♪>
song00002_off_f

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Everyone, it's time to get really pumped! Let's give Luka the celebration she really deserves!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I love this song!
It's so cute and cheerful♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, I like it a lot too.
Especially the lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
Luka sings a lot of songs that use English.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, she does! I even had her help me with my homework a few times.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Her pronunciation's ridiculously good too! She's like all, “Oh, I'm a native speaker!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: H-Hehe... Really?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can't tell.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Fine, we'll just have to go to SEKAI after this and ask Luka to say something in English for us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, not on her anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you guys won't get it if we don't!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm not kidding! Her English is unbelievably good! Maybe she'll sing something in English during this show...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <This show's just getting started, everyone. I want you all to make it really clear how you feel.>
